decisions.reason: The shared treatment for follow-on website pages is a separate item in the source message; adding the dashboard shell and canvas as console design targets does not change it.
The source decision adds dashboard shell and canvas design targets but does not alter the independently stated responsive behavior for the landing page and website layouts.
Planning the layout and styling of the dashboard shell and canvas does not change the landing page's visual theme, typography, colors, or other current design choices.
The source does not apply the landing-page font or button-color preferences to the dashboard shell or otherwise change the website design-token state.
Adding the dashboard shell and canvas as console design targets does not change the website implementation stack or handoff objective.
